errors.quote: Cells with comparable transcript measurements retain distinct surface-protein levels.
errors.issue: Conditioning on noisy observed RNA does not hold true transcript abundance fixed. A validated errors-in-variables/latent observation model is needed before attributing residual protein differences to regulation downstream of RNA.

errors.quote: These need not assay the same individual cells
errors.issue: Separate matched-aliquot RNA/protein validation checks marginal population changes, not the joint discordant-cell fraction. The answer acknowledges this limit later; a paired orthogonal single-cell measurement or appropriately weaker state claim is needed for the persistent-state conclusion.

errors.quote: Use this model to predict how many apparent discordant cells would occur if the underlying biological variables were coordinated.
errors.issue: The coordinated latent null and technical error model lack a specified likelihood, identifiable calibration, fitting and model-selection procedure. Rejecting a coordinated null does not uniquely identify a discrete state over continuous kinetics/heterogeneity.

errors.quote: Exact biological system, markers, perturbation, timing, panel, sample size
errors.issue: The proposed mechanistic workflow defers the actual system/target, perturbation/dose, assay settings and statistical implementation. Excellent development gates do not supply an executable experiment.

rationale: Strong alternative biological-discordance program with independent units, held-out model comparison, balanced time courses, sorting controls and explicit destructive-assay limits. Scientific quality is credited on its own merits. No learned cell-specific modality weighting or integrated-neighborhood construction is proposed, so it does not match the sealed WNN direction.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
The supplied assessment contains no raw data; a plan is not actual figure reproduction. Accessions should be sought in primary records, never invented.
